description: Amazon dark mode, Transit Bike mode and activity transmission, universal activity receiver, Niagara custom weather sources, and Gboard clipboard/translation tools.

patches.name: Custom weather sources
patches.description: Native weather settings, ordered/aggregated providers and customizable JSON mappings. Exact 1.16.31 build.

patches.name: Dark mode
patches.description: Force dark mode for Amazon Shopping.

patches.name: Better translate UX
patches.description: Changes translation languages with ISO/BCP language codes followed by whitespace. Adds an optional compact language-pair editor in Gboard settings.

patches.name: ClipCascade sync
patches.description: Adds pooled remote clipboard history, images and Send to all devices. Supports ClipCascade P2S/P2P. Configure the required server/account patch options before patching.

options.description: Required. ClipCascade server base URL, including https:// (or http:// on a trusted local network). No /login suffix.
Required. Your original ClipCascade password. Credentials are stored in the patched APK; do not share it.
Local limit for text/images, up to 16777216 bytes. The P2S server's limit also applies. Default: 8 MiB.
Must match the other clients; stock default is empty.
Must match the other clients. Stock default: 664937.

patches.name: Bike mode
patches.description: Bicycle-specific GO reminders (Get bike in N stops / SOON / NOW) with editable templates. Exact stock Transit 6.3.5 build.

patches.name: Personal Maps API key
patches.description: Uses your own Maps SDK for Android key so the map renders in patched Transit. Enter the key in this patch's options.

options.description: Required. Your Google Maps SDK for Android API key (starts with AIza, 39 characters).

patches.name: Physical Activity spoof [TRANSMITTER]
patches.description: Publishes IN_VEHICLE immediately while GO confirms you are aboard a vehicle. Requires a same-signer app patched with Physical Activity spoof [RECEIVER].

patches.description: Force dark mode for Amazon Shopping.

release_notes:
Gboard clipboard menu fix. Contains all eight Urro patches.

- **ClipCascade sync:** The Send action now uses the native middle-row spacing, divider, colors, and shape, so it fits between Edit and Delete.
- The existing ClipCascade, translation, Transit, Niagara, Amazon, and universal patches remain available.

Validation: Android bundle build, release safety checks, and application to clean Gboard 18.5.4 with GBoard community patches 4.0.0 and Gboard 18.0.3 with community patches 3.13.0. The updated Send appearance has not yet been visually verified on the phone.

Bundle source commit: `75646368ee8a2a127dcfcfb944cd0ef573ccc376`.
